budget_overrun_policy: if any Foundation ends below 8 complete families, v2 FAILS authoring yield; extending requires a NEW successor lock
cohort_rationale: backfill would make generation batch correlate with Foundation, creating a lexical shortcut through production history
june_gate_granularity: the June surface gate is a corpus-level cross-validated measure, so it runs once over the completed selected corpus BEFORE freezing and BEFORE any readout — gating admission of the corpus, never a post-hoc audit of a scored result
regeneration_scope: FULL CORPUS under one process — NOT a backfill
selection_rule: first 3 candidates passing the frozen DIRECT-LEAK REGEX, in frozen generation order. A selected sibling is NEVER replaced by candidate 4 or 5 for a better surface score or judge prediction.
supersedes: v1 (513 accepted, 126/224 complete families) — retained as NOT_FROZEN / NOT_SCORED / AUTHORING-YIELD EVIDENCE
